title: Industrial Autonomy, powered by Wipro Intelligence™
summary: Engineering intelligence into connected, resilient and autonomous industrial operations
body_markdown:
### FAQs — What Industrial autonomy leaders are asking


####


What does Industrial Autonomy mean for an enterprise already investing in Industry 4.0?


Industrial Autonomy builds on the connected foundations of Industry 4.0 by bringing engineering, operational technology, data, AI and physical automation into a more integrated model. Wipro's approach connects capabilities across product engineering, PLM, factories, assets and operations, creating the digital foundation needed to progress towards increasingly intelligent and autonomous operations.


####


How can we connect engineering and manufacturing instead of transforming them separately?


A connected digital thread provides the bridge. Wipro's portfolio spans engineering design, PLM, Digital Twin, MES/MOM, IoT and operational systems, helping connect information across the product lifecycle. This enables engineering and operational data to move more effectively across design, development, manufacturing and sustainment rather than remaining isolated within individual systems.


####


How can we modernise factories without replacing our entire OT environment?


Industrial transformation can incorporate existing plant environments alongside modern capabilities. Wipro's portfolio covers SCADA and PLC systems, historians, MES harmonisation, IT-OT integration, Industrial IoT and managed operations, alongside Digital Twin and Industrial AI capabilities. This creates a path for modernising and connecting industrial systems while progressing towards more intelligent operations.


####


Where does AI create value in industrial operations?


Wipro's Industrial Autonomy portfolio applies intelligence across Industrial IoT, Digital Twins, assets and physical operations. Capabilities include machine learning, GenAI, Industrial AI agents, industrial LLMs, predictive analytics, multi-agent systems and Edge/Embodied AI, alongside predictive asset management and autonomous robotics.


####


How can Digital Twins help us move towards autonomous operations?


Wipro positions Digital Twins across four areas: engineering twins connecting engineering data and 3D models; operational twins addressing production, processes, assets, maintenance and energy; simulation twins supporting virtual commissioning and Physical AI; and autonomous twins incorporating Industrial AI, Agentic AI and autonomous operations.


####


What role does Physical AI play in Industrial Autonomy?


Physical AI brings intelligence into machines and physical operating environments. Wipro's portfolio combines AI-powered simulation, autonomous robotics, embodied and agentic AI, Digital Twins and immersive operations. Use cases presented include autonomous material handling, furnace operations, surface-quality inspection, predictive-maintenance robots and drone-based asset inspection


####


How do we connect products, factories, assets and operations into one transformation programme?


Wipro's Industrial Autonomy model spans the lifecycle from ideate, design and develop, manufacture, sustain through disposal. Engineering Design Services, PLM, Connected Enterprise and Integrated Workplace & Asset Management form the core service pillars, supported by Industrial AI, Physical AI and Robotics, sustainability and engineering capabilities.
